task.title: Create a Sync
task.shortdesc: Create a sync configuration to define how content moves from Heretto Deploy to a target system such as Salesforce Knowledge.

prereq.p: Before you create a sync, confirm that:

ul.li: You have a Deployment ID from your Heretto Deploy instance.
You have the credentials needed to connect to your target system (for example, Salesforce client ID and client secret), or a saved credential already exists in the Syndication Service.
For Salesforce targets: any data category groups you want to map have been created in Salesforce Setup.

step.cmd: In the navigation menu, click Syncs.

step.stepresult: The sync is saved and you are taken to the Sync Detail page. If you configured an automatic schedule, the sync will run at the next scheduled time. To run it immediately, see .
